payload.title: Refresh living report while linked task is active
payload.description:
An open living Report remains on its initial ReportBlock revision while the backend publishes later milestones. Operators only see the latest Procedure Task and report evidence after navigating or reloading.

Feature: Live milestone visibility

Scenario: A running report publishes a new milestone
Given an operator has a living Report open
And its linked Task is nonterminal
When the backend updates the Task and ReportBlock artifact pointer
Then the open page displays the new progress and Report revision without manual reload

Scenario: A linked task becomes terminal
Given live refresh is active for a living Report
When the linked Task reaches a terminal state
Then the page displays the terminal Report revision
And background refresh stops
